record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> concerning all the people<WH05971> of Judah<WH03063> in the fourth<WH07243> year<WH08141> of Jehoiakim<WH03079> the son<WH01121> of Josiah<WH02977> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, that <FI>was<Fi>  the first<WH07224> year<WH08141> of Nebuchadrezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>;
